title: polygala calcarea subsp. corbariensis
intro: Polygala calcarea subsp. corbariensis, commonly known as the French lavender polygala, is a plant species within the Polygalaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Polygala calcarea subsp. corbariensis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
